page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This configuration provides a one-to-one ratio of physical cores to vCPUs with one thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading contention.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

This hardware profile is suited for workloads requiring high single-core performance and dedicated CPU allocation, such as relational databases, application servers, and general-purpose enterprise applications. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for compute-heavy and memory-balanced tasks that rely on external storage volumes.
